title: Transport of closed-Hom comparison along adjoint isomorphisms
statement: For the two closed tensor-Hom categories and the five-bijection comparison [lem-sfb-closed-scalar-hom-comparison], let F,Fprime be left adjoints to U,Uprime, with d:Uprime≅U and c:F≅Fprime. Suppose the scalar hom equivalences intertwine c and d, and the two strong tensor maps intertwine c in both inputs. Then their closed-Hom comparisons intertwine d in the output and c contravariantly in the first internal-Hom input. The canonical leftAdjointUniq map has the required scalar-transpose compatibility. For the identity adjunction and identity tensor comparison, the closed-Hom comparison is the identity.

proof.text: Apply the representing identity and naturality under precomposition. The outer closed transpose moves the output map d through by naturality. Scalar-transpose compatibility moves d across the scalar adjunction. Naturality of the inner uncurrying moves c in both tensor factors. The strong tensor compatibility identifies the resulting maps.

proof.text: For the canonical left-adjoint uniqueness map, hom-equivalence naturality and its unit identity give precisely the scalar-transpose compatibility. For the identity, the scalar equivalences are identities and the closed equivalences cancel.
